name: cohost
description: Locally hosted AI VTuber co-host — modular services on a Redis bus

scripts.build:native: cargo build --release -p cohost-bus-node && mkdir -p packages/bus/native && cp target/release/libcohost_bus_node.so packages/bus/native/cohost-bus.linux-x64-gnu.node
scripts.dashboard: pnpm docs:build || echo 'pnpm dashboard: the docs build failed (see above); starting the dashboard anyway' >&2; pnpm --filter @cohost/dashboard build:ui && tsc -b services/dashboard && node services/dashboard/dist/index.js
scripts.test: pnpm build:native && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @cohost/dashboard build:ui && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.test.json node --import tsx --test "packages/*/test/*.test.ts" "services/*/test/*.test.ts" "services/*/test/ui/*.test.tsx"
scripts.docs:build: node scripts/docs-check.mjs && vitepress build docs && node scripts/docs-check.mjs --dist
